summary: Boy aged 8 beaten with a belt by his stepfather, bleeding; still living together.
text: please help, my nephew is 8 and his stepfather beats him with a belt, last night he was bleeding on his back. they still live together in Eastfield. im scared it happens again tonight

summary: Neighbour's child often shouted at and locked in, not fed yesterday.
text: Hello, the child next door is constantly screamed at and locked in a room. Yesterday I heard her say she had not eaten all day. I don't know who else to tell.

summary: Tutor insults a child repeatedly; parent wants advice.
text: Mi hijo de 10 años dice que su profesor particular lo insulta y lo llama tonto en cada clase. ¿Qué puedo hacer? No quiero que deje de estudiar.

summary: Girl aged 12 molested by an uncle who still visits the house.
text: My 12 year old daughter told me her uncle touched her when I was at work. He still comes to our house every weekend. I don't know what to do, please help us.

summary: Student harassed by a teacher; other students affected too.
text: Bonjour, ma fille de 14 ans et deux de ses camarades sont harcelées par un enseignant au collège de Northgate. Il leur envoie des messages et les touche. L'école ne réagit pas.

summary: Boy aged 16 promised a job abroad, now unreachable.
text: Ate, yung pamangkin ko 16 years old, may nag-alok ng trabaho sa abroad, umalis siya noong isang linggo at hindi na namin ma-contact. Hindi namin kilala ang recruiter.

summary: Children made to beg at a traffic light by the same adults every day.
text: Every morning the same two adults drop off small children at the Central Market traffic light to beg and collect the money in the evening. This has gone on for weeks.

summary: Girl aged 13 threatened by an online gaming contact to share private photos, asked for more.
text: Someone my daughter (13) met in an online game says he will post her private photos unless she sends more. She is terrified and hasn't told her father. What do we do?

summary: Class chat group shares a video of a child being bullied.
text: A video of my son being pushed and laughed at is being shared in his class group chat at Riverside Primary. He refuses to go back to school.

summary: Ex-husband took the 4-year-old away; no access.
text: Meu ex-marido levou nosso filho de 4 anos há duas semanas e não me deixa ver nem falar com ele. Não sei onde estão.

summary: Father not paying child support after divorce despite court order.
text: Since our divorce last year my ex-husband has not paid the child support the court ordered. Is there anything your office can do?

summary: Asks whether the service can mediate custody.
text: Hi, can your office help mediate custody between me and my ex? We want to avoid going to court.

summary: Child bullied by older students, refuses to go to school.
text: My daughter in grade 4 at Riverside Primary has been bullied by older kids for two weeks and now refuses to go to school. Her teacher knows but nothing changed.

summary: School charges compulsory fees for uniforms and a trip.
text: Riverside Primary is charging every family for a new uniform and a compulsory school trip. Many of us cannot pay and the children are told they will be left out.

summary: Child hit by a classmate in the school toilet, bruised.
text: my son came home with bruises, a classmate hit him in the toilet at Riverside Primary. third time this month. the school says boys will be boys

summary: Report card withheld over unpaid school fees.
text: Riverside Primary is holding back my son's report card because we owe fees. He needs it to move to his new school.

summary: Suggests schools have an anti-bullying counsellor.
text: Suggestion: every school should have a counsellor kids can talk to about bullying. Would your office support this?

summary: Toddler malnourished and losing weight; family cannot reach the clinic.
text: Bé nhà hàng xóm 2 tuổi rất gầy, sụt cân nhiều, gia đình nghèo không có tiền đi trạm y tế. Xin hãy giúp.

summary: Child refused vaccination for lacking a local address document.
text: The Northgate Health Centre refused to vaccinate my baby because our residence papers are from another district. Is that allowed?

summary: Asks how to report and the office hours.
text: How do I report a concern about a child and what are your hours?

summary: Wants to volunteer for child protection.
text: Nataka kujitolea kusaidia watoto walio hatarini. Ninawezaje kujiunga?

summary: Neighbour's child often heard crying and being hit by the mother.
text: Almost every night I hear the little boy next door crying and being hit by his mother. Today he had a bruise on his face.
